reason: The commissioning of the 400kV Jalpura-Khurja transmission corridor and 1,000 MVA substation expands the company's transmission capacity in the National Capital Region, directly increasing revenue-generating infrastructure assets.
why_now: The company filed the official commissioning notice on September 03, 2026.
source_headlines: Tata Power Company Limited: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 03, 2026, titled "Press release titled Tata Power Strengthens NCR s Power Infrastructure with Commissioning of 400kV Jalpura-Khurja Transmission Corridor, comprising 162 CKM Transmission lines and 1,000 MVA Substation .".
